case_name: Thuttagudala Mounika Nagalakshmi Devi vs Thutta Suresh Babu

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: THUTTA(GUDALA) MOUNIKA NAGALAKSHMI DEVI, W/O THUTTA SURESH BABU
parties.respondent_defendant: THUTTA SURESH BABU, S/o Late Rambabu

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner wife filed petition under Section 24 of the C.P.C. seeking withdrawal of F.C.O.P.No.2079 of 2024 and transfer to Family Court cum IXth Additional District and Sessions Court, Rajamahendravaram.

legal_principles.principle: Service held sufficient when the respondent does not appear despite being served.
legal_principles.held: Though registered notice sent to the respondent and the same was served on him, none appeared for the respondent. Therefore, 'service held sufficient'.

legal_principles.principle: A woman's residence with her parents is not a bar to seeking relief in court.
legal_principles.held: The material on record prima facie goes to shows that, in view of the matrimonial disputes, the petitioner/wife has been residing separately at her parents' house at Bommuru Village, East Godavari District...
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

outcome.final_order: Service held sufficient; petition allowed; restitution petition withdrawn and transferred to Family Court cum IXth Additional District and Sessions Court, Rajamahendravaram.
